sections.heading: Carried by more than one source

items.title: AWS Introduces Lambda Web Functions for Node.js Applications
items.blurb: AWS recently introduced Lambda Web Functions, allowing developers to run Node.js web applications using frameworks such as Express and Hono directly on Lambda, with support for concurrent requests and response streaming. By Renato Losio

items.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
Web Search on Amazon Bedrock now supports domain filtering and user location controls
items.blurb: Web Search on Amazon Bedrock now supports two new controls that give you more precision over the results that ground a model's response: domain filtering and user location.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer Global Resiliency now supports persistent chat across linked AWS Regions
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer Global Resiliency now provides customers a mechanism to deliver long, persistent chat experiences across linked AWS Regions.

items.title: AWS Transit Gateway and AWS Cloud WAN now support 1:1 NAT
items.blurb: AWS Transit Gateway and AWS Cloud WAN now provide managed one-to-one network address translation (NAT) directly on their attachments, through integration with Regional Private NAT Gateway.

items.title: Amazon Corretto October 2026 Quarterly Updates
items.blurb: On October 22, 2026 Amazon announced quarterly security and critical updates for Amazon Corretto Long-Term Supported (LTS) versions of OpenJDK.

items.title: Cloudflare Reclaims 100 TB of RAM by Optimizing Consistent Hashing
items.blurb: Cloudflare recently documented how it reduced the memory footprint of its internal load-balancing service by more than 100 TB by optimizing the Rust implementation of consistent hashing in pingora-ketama.

items.title: CSIRO Uses Serverless Architecture to Query 100x More Genomic Variants on AWS
items.blurb: CSIRO has developed Serverless Beacon, a serverless architecture for querying genomic variants without copying VCF files into a central database.
